description: The page cache of one of the customer's own websites: get (state, excluded paths, last cleared), enable, disable, clear, add_path (keep a path out of the cache) and remove_path. Enable, disable and path changes need a confirm; clear does not (at most once per 30 seconds per site). A shop is switched on by support after a check.

action.description: get (default), enable, disable, clear, add_path or remove_path.

domain.description: Primary domain of the website, instead of serviceId.

path.description: add_path / remove_path: path that starts with a slash, e.g. /booking.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id of the website.

name: oma_page_cache
title: Website page cache
